claim_verdicts.evidence: ProductsController.cs@stage-2 lines 10-29 (as quoted in design.l2.composition-root): `public sealed class ProductsController(DonHangDbContext db, IProductRepository products)`; List takes `int? maxPriceVnd`, comment `Sorting by the unique id keeps every page in the same, fixed order`, body starts `IQueryable<Product> query = db.Products;` (so Product is accessible from DonHang.Api; no InternalsVisibleTo in repo). DonHangDbContext.cs: `public sealed class DonHangDbContext(...)`; Entities.cs@stage-1: `public sealed class Product`.

Search `^(public|internal)` over DonHang.Catalog gives 9 lines: public static class CatalogModule; public sealed record CatalogProduct(int Id, string Name, int PriceVnd); public interface ICatalog; internal sealed class CatalogDbContext / CatalogService / EfProductRepository / Product / ProductCache; internal interface IProductRepository. Grep for InternalsVisibleTo across the repo: no matches. Read from the working tree (HEAD 7ef8fff); `git show stage-3:` could not be run in this session (command needs approval).

Round 2: claim and section 3 now say 'same assembly, the DLL its project builds'. internal keyword: "You can access internal types or members only within files in the same assembly"; "It's an error to reference a type or a member with internal access outside the assembly where you defined it." Example: `var myBase = new BaseClass();   // CS0122`. One csproj = one DLL in this repo; no InternalsVisibleTo.

ICatalog.cs lines 3-19: `Task<List<CatalogProduct>> ListAsync(int limit, int offset, int? maxPriceVnd);` `Task<CatalogProduct?> FindAsync(int id);` `Task<CatalogProduct?> ChangePriceAsync(int id, int priceVnd);` with comments 'or null when no product has this id'. CatalogProduct.cs:6 `public sealed record CatalogProduct(int Id, string Name, int PriceVnd);`. Lesson block matches these lines character for character.

Round 2 (diagram labels, IProductRepository named). CatalogService.cs:8 `internal sealed class CatalogService(CatalogDbContext db, IProductRepository products) : ICatalog`; ListAsync reads `db.Products`, `.Where(p => p.PriceVnd <= maxPriceVnd)`, `.OrderBy(p => p.Id)`; FindAsync -> products.FindAsync; ChangePriceAsync -> products.UpdatePriceAsync. EfProductRepository.cs:5 `: IProductRepository`; CatalogModule.cs:38-44 IProductRepository -> new ProductCache(EfProductRepository), `AddScoped<ICatalog, CatalogService>()`.

ProductsController.cs:16 `public sealed class ProductsController(ICatalog catalog) : ControllerBase`; List: `await catalog.ListAsync(limit, offset, maxPriceVnd)` then `page.Select(ToDto).ToList()`; Get: `catalog.FindAsync(id)`; UpdatePrice: `catalog.ChangePriceAsync(id, request.PriceVnd)`. Lesson block = lines 10-32 exactly.

Round 2 (claim now adds parameter types, CS0051). CS0050 page: "The return type and each of the types referenced in the formal parameter list of a method must be at least as accessible as the method itself. This includes type arguments of generic types used in the return type" - covers return and parameter types of a public method; the new section 3 sentence matches.
Product.cs:7-12 `internal sealed class Product { public int Id { get; set; } public required string Name { get; set; } public int PriceVnd { get; set; } }`.

Round 2: claim text now equals round-1 suggested_text. git-grep(1): `<tree>...`: "Instead of searching tracked files in the working tree, search blobs in the given trees." `-n`: "Prefix the line number to matching lines." `-E`: "Use POSIX extended/basic regexp for patterns."

Round 2: design judgement now stated with its condition (all three public types, incl. CatalogModule). Consistent with code: public AddCatalogModule (CatalogModule.cs:12-15) is called from DonHang.Api. Section 4 'A change to the contract is the only kind that reaches callers' and q6 'only a change to the contract can reach callers' now agree with section 7.

Design judgement stated with its condition (one process vs another process); consistent with the code: ProductsController calls ICatalog by a direct method call, no HTTP client between DonHang.Api and DonHang.Catalog.
Design judgement; the code fact under it (stage-2 ProductsController queried DonHangDbContext directly because Product/DonHangDbContext were public) is covered by claim 1.
